scenarios.name: Cash drawer lifecycle (G.6.1) — open → record → close → reconcile
scenarios.ui_path_traced: PosComponent.vue:242 button [data-testid=pos-cash-session-open] → openCashSessionDialog() → showCashSessionDialog=true → PosCashDrawerSessionDialog.vue (4 modes: open/active/close/movements) → Vuex cashDrawer module → CashDrawerService.js → POST /api/admin/pos/cash-drawer/sessions/{open,close,reconcile} → CashDrawerSessionController → CashDrawerService → AuditLogService::write
scenarios.audit_log_event_chain: cash.session.opened → cash.movement.recorded (N times) → cash.session.closed → cash.session.reconciled (4 events per shift typically)
invariants_verified_by_code_read: I1 openSession refuses double-open via (a) Cache::lock 5s, (b) DB::transaction lockForUpdate, (c) UNIQUE partial (branch_id, opened_by_user_id) WHERE status='open' — see migration 2026_05_10_020000
I2 closeSession idempotent on already-closed (no-op + skip audit)
I3 reconcile computes expected = opening + Σ signed movements, variance = closing - expected
I4 recordMovement refuses if session not OPEN (race-resistant via lockForUpdate)
I6 variance > config('cash.variance_threshold_eur',2.00€) requires variance_reason + cash.reconcile.variance.override permission
audit_logs write best-effort wrapped in try/catch — never blocks cash op (F.10 verified chain still works)
POS-RED-04 ownership: same-branch users must own session OR hold variance.override permission to act on someone else's drawer (incl. close)

scenarios.name: Z-close cash reconciliation (G.6.3)
scenarios.z_aggregates_window: (previousClose, thisClose] half-open per branch_id, on orders.created_at where fiscal_sequence_no IS NOT NULL AND payment_status != UNPAID
cash_aggregation_path: ZReportService::aggregate aggregates orders → total_by_method (per pos_payment_method). For CASH mode, this is the gross cash collected for the day.

ZReportCashEnrichmentService::aggregateForWindow walks CashDrawerSession reconciled rows in same window → sums opening_amount / closing_amount / variance + counts movements. Stored in z_reports columns post-close (hors signature HMAC).
ZReportCashEnrichmentService::aggregateByTerminal groups OrderPayment by terminal_id → breakdown CASH vs CARD + fees → net_after_fees. RUNTIME only (never persisted, never signed).
ZReportCashEnrichmentService::enrichClose (V1.0.2 Wave 6b-1.5) ALSO aggregates DeliveryBoyCashSession + DeliveryBoyCashMovement for the same window — runtime only, NOT persisted, NOT signed.
scenarios.reconciliation_NOT_a_hard_gate: Z-close DOES NOT require all CashDrawerSession to be reconciled. It aggregates order_payments regardless of session state. This is by design — cashier may forget to reconcile, but the fiscal Z still must be signable. The cash_variance column on z_reports surfaces the sum of all reconciled-session variances in the window for ops review (NOT for fiscal integrity which depends on order_payments only).
scenarios.soft_delete_handling: Z aggregate uses withTrashed() so soft-deleted post-allocation orders ARE counted (P0-FIX-1/2 iter15 owner G0-A). Logical exclusion via $terminalStatuses whitelist (CANCELED/REJECTED/RETURNED) only.
scenarios.orphan_warning: warnOnOrphanedPaidOrders writes a fiscal-channel WARN when kiosk-paid orders in window still miss fiscal_sequence_no (retry cron in flight). Excludes them from aggregate (correct), but surfaces the gap so ops can delay close until alloc retry catches up.
scenarios.consistency_probe: ZReportCashEnrichmentService::verifyConsistencyVsAuditLog (delivery side) — sums audit_logs cash.delivery.movement.recorded vs delivery_boy_cash_movements rows in window → discrepancy list. NO equivalent probe exists for POS cash_movements (gap — V1.0.X).
scenarios.verdict: GREEN code, well-decorated, append-only chain preserved

scenarios.name: Multi-cashier handover (G.6.4)
scenarios.scenario_described: Cashier A opens session 09:00 → close+reconcile 13:00 → Cashier B opens 13:00 → close+reconcile 18:00 → Owner closes Z 23:00 → aggregates BOTH sessions' day data
evidence: UNIQUE partial index keyed on (branch_id, opened_by_user_id) WHERE status='open' — verified migration 2026_05_10_020000 — allows multiple distinct cashiers to each hold an OPEN session simultaneously on the same branch (the legacy 'one drawer per branch' assumption is NOT in the code).
openSession ownership scoped per (branch_id, user_id) — Cashier A and Cashier B don't contend for the same lock key (cash_drawer_open_b{branch}_u{user}).

CashDrawerSessionController::assertSessionVisibleToUser (POS-RED-04 hardening) requires Cashier B to either own his session or hold cash.reconcile.variance.override to close someone else's drawer — owner trains owner the manager pattern OR the standard A-closes-A / B-closes-B pattern (recommended).

ZReportCashEnrichmentService::aggregateForWindow walks ALL CashDrawerSession rows for the branch in (from, to] regardless of opened_by_user_id — multi-cashier sessions are naturally summed in the Z enrichment.

audit_logs append-only HMAC chain records every transition with branch_id + user_id payload — 8+ audit rows expected for the scenario above (4 events per cashier × 2 cashiers, plus Z-open/close adds 2 more).
scenarios.test_coverage_gap: CashDrawerConcurrentSessionTest covers SINGLE-USER TOCTOU race only (1 branch, 1 user, simultaneous open). NO test asserts the full A → B handover scenario with the 3 transitions + Z aggregation across two distinct opened_by_user_id. Code is correct by construction but unobserved.
scenarios.v1_recommendation: Add a Feature test tests/Feature/Cash/MultiCashierHandoverTest.php asserting: (1) A and B can both have OPEN sessions simultaneously, (2) sessionA closes+reconciles + sessionB closes+reconciles → both reconciled state, (3) Z-close aggregates both via ZReportCashEnrichmentService::aggregateForWindow (sum of variances = expected), (4) audit_logs receives 8 cash.session.* events before any Z event. Effort: ≤2h.
scenarios.verdict: GREEN code path, AMBER test coverage

v1_options: A) Owner trains a daily routine 'curl POST /admin/fiscal/z-report/close' with stored session token — feasible but fragile

ui_gaps.title: No manual cash-movement UI
ui_gaps.evidence: PosCashDrawerSessionDialog.vue has 4 modes: open/active/close/movements. The 'movements' mode is READ-ONLY (lists existing cash_movements rows). The only way to record a new movement today is internal calls from PaymentService hook (order payment → TYPE_ORDER_PAYMENT) and from CashDrawerController::open (hardware drawer pop → TYPE_DRAWER_OPEN). TYPE_ADJUSTMENT exists in the enum but no UI surface emits it.
ui_gaps.impact: Cashier cannot record a change-fund top-up (e.g. manager hands €50 cash to cashier mid-shift), a withdrawal (e.g. cashier puts excess €100 into safe), or a discrepancy adjustment via UI. Such events become invisible to the cash reconciliation math → variance shows up at close but operator cannot explain it from the movements list.
ui_gaps.v1_owner_decision_needed: Owner Q: does the daily ops flow require manual cash adjustments (top-up / withdrawal / void) ? If YES, add a 5th dialog mode 'adjust' wired to CashDrawerService::recordMovement(type='adjustment'). If NO (every cash flow is order-payment or hardware-pop only), document this decision in the V1 SCOPE and move on.
ui_gaps.effort_if_yes: ≤2h add modal + i18n + backend whitelist validation already in service

top_3_operational_concerns: (P1) Z-close has NO trigger today — no button, no cron, no documented manual procedure. Owner must run a custom curl or php tinker every night to close, otherwise the Z stays open and the next day's orders accumulate into a multi-day Z with broken (from, to] semantics relative to operator expectation.

(P1) No cashier-facing daily ops runbook — fiscal/backup/migration runbooks exist but the actual shift open/close/Z procedure from the cashier's POV is undocumented. Risk: cashier improvises, variance reasons go unrecorded, manager doesn't know when to gate variance > threshold.

(P2) Multi-cashier handover supported by code (UNIQUE partial keyed on branch+user, ownership gate POS-RED-04, Z enrichment walks all sessions in window) but NO test asserts the full A→B handover + Z aggregation. Risk is silent regression if a future refactor narrows the UNIQUE key to (branch_id) only.

notes: Multi-cashier handover code path is CORRECT BY CONSTRUCTION — UNIQUE partial allows A+B parallel OPEN sessions, lock keys distinct per user, enrichment service walks all sessions in window. Untested but provably correct from code read.

ZReportCashEnrichmentService is a textbook decorator pattern preserving the frozen ZReportService HMAC signature — cash_variance / cash_opening_amount / cash_closing_amount / cash_movements_count are persisted on z_reports POST-signature so the HMAC stays intact across legacy + new reports.
Delivery cash enrichment (V1.0.2 Wave 6b-1.5) added the same window semantics for DeliveryBoyCashSession — runtime only, never persisted (no z_reports column added), keeps chain bit-identical.

F.10's empirical service-layer test (orders 484/485/486, Z6 close) proved the Z aggregates compute correctly — G.6 did NOT re-run empirically. G.6 is the code-static + UI-trace counterpart that surfaces the trigger gap.
Owner decision needed before V1 LIVE: (a) ship button + cron safety-net, or (b) accept manual curl procedure with explicit runbook training. Either path closes G6-FIND-1 + G6-FIND-2.
